# write transform based on enclosed rectangular outlines
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set()
    # Objects are solid-color rectangular frames; fill their enclosed interiors.
    colors=set(v for row in g for v in row if v != 9)
    for color in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        # A rectangular frame has all four perimeter sides in its color.
        if r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2 and all(g[r0][c]==color and g[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][c0]==color and g[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            fill=color+1 if color%2==0 else color-1
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if g[r][c]==9: g[r][c]=fill
    return g
'''
